kicker: Two views of the same church
title: Pastors see more mental health care in their churches than churchgoers do
subtitle: U.S. Protestant senior pastors and monthly churchgoers, 2017
caption: 46% of pastors say their church regularly addresses mental illness; 12% of churchgoers say the same. On every measure pastors describe more help than the pews see.
note: Each group was asked whether its own church does each thing. The two samples are different churches, so the gap shows a difference in perception, not a check on any one congregation.

sources.study: Suicide and the Church Research Study (Suicide Remains a Taboo Topic at Churches)
sources.field_dates: Pastors by phone, Aug. 30 to Sept. 18, 2017; churchgoers online, Sept. 15 to 19, 2017
sources.sample: 1,000 Protestant senior pastors (plus or minus 3.2 points) and 1,000 Protestant and nondenominational churchgoers attending at least monthly (plus or minus 3.4 points)
